title: The Corporate logo on the wall
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：corporate　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 corporate 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the painter wrote of ① a corporate logo on the wall in the catalogue, and everybody in the studio said at once that it was ② more corporate than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the painter, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the corporate ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most corporate logo on the wall anybody in the studio had ever seen, or so the catalogue for May 1969 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too corporate to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the corporate ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a corporate plan for the merger, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as corporate as the plan for the merger they had once had in the old studio. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was corporate or not, and he said so.

By 1982 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue. What the line asked for was ⑦ something corporate, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next studio called the whole plan ⑧ quite corporate; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the catalogue kept the names of the corporate ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1985, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another corporate logo on the wall in the same catalogue, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ more corporate than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most corporate plan for the merger in the whole studio, she said in 1987, was the one she could never quite name; the corporate ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 公司（前置定语 a corporate logo on the wall：1975 年画师在展品目录里记下的那件公司的标识）
B. adj. 公司／团体（比较级 more corporate than：文中两处，一处比墙上的标识，一处比预想）
C. adj. 公司／团体（最高级 the most corporate：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 公司（表语 too corporate to do：母亲觉得它太公司，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 团体（前置定语 a corporate plan for the merger：叔叔把整件事称作一桩团体的方案）
F. adj. 团体（同级比较 as corporate as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩合并的方案相比）
G. adj. 团体（后置定语 something corporate：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 团体（受程度副词修饰 quite corporate：那位观者的评价）

items.q: a corporate logo on the wall
the most corporate logo on the wall anybody
a corporate plan for the merger
The most corporate plan for the merger in

answers.why: corporate 意为“公司”，1975 年画师在展品目录里记下的是“一件公司的标识”，此处作前置定语 a corporate logo on the wall。
corporate 意为“公司”，此处用比较级 more corporate than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
corporate 意为“公司”，展品目录上 五月 那行字说它是画室里最公司的一件，故用最高级 the most corporate logo on the wall。
corporate 意为“公司”，母亲认为这件东西“太公司了，谁也用不上”，too corporate to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
corporate 意为“团体”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩团体的方案”，此处作前置定语 a corporate plan for the merger。
corporate 意为“团体”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩合并的方案一样团体”，同级比较用 as corporate as。
corporate 意为“团体”，展品目录上那半行字要的是“团体的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something corporate。
corporate 意为“团体”，邻画室来的那位观者认为这套计划“相当团体”，quite 修饰原级 corporate。
corporate 意为“团体”，1985 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要团体”，故用比较级 more corporate than。
corporate 意为“团体”，母亲 1987 年说的是“整个画室里最团体的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most corporate plan for the merger。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年，画师在展品目录里记下了一件公司的标识。（a corporate logo on the wall）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更公司。（more corporate than …）
母亲觉得它太公司，谁也用不上。（too corporate to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩团体的方案。（a corporate plan for the merger）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩合并的方案一样团体。（as corporate as …）
到了 1982 年，展品目录上只剩半行字：要的是一件团体的东西。（something corporate）
answers: In 1975 the painter wrote of a corporate logo on the wall in the catalogue.
Everybody said it was more corporate than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too corporate to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a corporate plan for the merger.
He said nobody would call it as corporate as the plan for the merger they had once had.
By 1982 the catalogue asked for nothing but something corporate.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 corporate 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the painter wrote of a corporate logo on the wall in the catalogue, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most corporate logo on the wall in the studio, or so the catalogue says.
My mother thought it too corporate to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a corporate plan for the merger, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next studio called the plan quite corporate, and everybody laughed.
The corporate ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
